newsitem.title: HUNGARY: YEAR-HIGH FX FUTURES TRADE AS YEN,SFR RISE SHARPLY.
newsitem.headline: YEAR-HIGH FX FUTURES TRADE AS YEN,SFR RISE SHARPLY.

text.p: Sharp falls in the dollar/yen on international spot markets provoked the highest turnover this year on the Budapest Commodity Exchange forex futures market on Tuesday as it opened after the long Whitsun weekend.
The yen, dollar, mark and Swiss franc all saw large volumes, with the Swiss franc registering over half of the huge 14.08 billion forints turnover.
"There was no doubt the strengthening of the yen and the Swiss franc was the reason for the large turnover," one trader said.

The yen registered large rises of 3.73 and 3.60 forints for June and September to 161.60 and 170.10 forints per 100 yen respectively, while the Swiss franc also saw sharp increases of between 2.00 and 2.40 forints, with most deals done for December, which ended at 141.50.
Both the dollar and mark ended mixed.
The central bank fixed its midday spot rates at 159.05 per 100 yen, up 2.52 on Friday, 128.21 for the Swiss franc, up 1.63, 180.84 for the dollar, down 0.23 and 106.73 for the mark, up 0.12.
The much smaller forex futures market of the Budapest Stock Exchange, which trades only in the dollar, mark and Ecu, saw no turnover.
